svg.aria-label: What is in the box. In the box, what an app author imports: curated package roots for core, engine, client, react and testing, where every name has an outside consumer or a README entry; one call per job, to answer a stop, to read an action's output, to scroll a conversation; a quick start and examples that run as written; no tracker ids in anything that ships. Composed in by the adopter who goes further: named public subpaths, documented and semver-covered: core/harness, engine/host, testing/benchmark, patterns/benchmark, react/workforce, each store's host entry, and orchestration/tasks, the browser-safe entry it already has. Behind a fence, ours: internal subpaths in core, engine, orchestration, react and contracts, one each, published for our own packages and outside semver, and workspace-only entries for repo tests and tools. Not built here: the review's unfiled items.
